blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon – Agents of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) dismantled an alleged drug den and arrested five men during an anti-illegal drug operation in Bacoor City, Cavite. In a belated report Thursday, PDEA Calabarzon said its Cavite provincial office conducted a buy-bust operation that led to the raid of the suspected drug den in Barangay Molino 3 on Wednesday night. The operation resulted in the arrest of five drug suspects. The report did not identify the drug den maintainer among the suspects.
